summary_rationale: Aurobindo Pharma has built genuine global manufacturing scale across US generics (₹14,408 Cr in FY26; jumping 25.2% YoY to ₹4,555 Cr in Q2 FY27 post-Lannett), Europe (₹10,315 Cr in FY26, crossing €1B), and backward-integrated Penicillin-G fermentation at Kakinada (10,000 MTPA run-rate, EBITDA-positive ex-PLI), driving record Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹10,263 Cr, 21.0% EBITDA margin, and USD 189 million net cash. Yet three structural drags prevent an unconditional compounder classification: (1) chronic multi-site sterile compliance failures culminating in the August 13, 2026 USFDA Warning Letter at Eugia Unit I alongside lingering OAI status at Eugia Units II and III, capping complex injectable ANDA approvals; (2) ROCE compression from 25%–27% (FY15–FY17) to 12.9% after heavy multi-year capex (CWIP peaking at ₹5,214 Cr in FY26) and generic price-erosion cycles; and (3) a 326-day inventory cycle creating a 252-day cash conversion cycle alongside historical promoter governance scrutiny.
